package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type PracticeLearningRouteRepository interface {
	GetByTaskInstance(context.Context, string) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error)
	GetByID(context.Context, string) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error)
	Ensure(context.Context, domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, bool, error)
}

type PracticeLearningReadinessRepository interface {
	GetByIdempotencyKey(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, error)
	EnsureReadiness(context.Context, domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, bool, error)
}

type PracticeLearningCatalog interface {
	ResolveDefinitions(context.Context, []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error)
}
